dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: Of course. I want to go out exploring with you again. Visit new places, see new things.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: On that note, I've been meaning to ask you something. When we've been out on the hunt in the past, I've noticed you've actually got an edge over me.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: How did you learn to hunt like you do? Or rather... who taught you?

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: Ha. And modest about it too. So I guess you started out with natural talent and then worked at it relentlessly.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: Plus, you go on all these adventures to hone your skills. That's what's really shaped you into who you are today.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: A lot like me, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: I started out okay. Then Rost really trained me up.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: He was a great hunter. And an even better man.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: I hope he'd be proud of who I am today.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sure he would be very proud.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: Thanks. But to be honest, the only reason I started training in the first place was to win the Proving and get a boon from the Matriarchs. I wanted to know who my parents were.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: Back then, I never thought I'd be uniting everyone against an evil machine and its army.

dialogues.speaker: Aloy
dialogues.text: In fact, I probably would have found the idea of everyone uniting together even more far-fetched than the part about the evil machine.

choices.text: Nobody knows what the future holds.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: Yeah. But I actually kind of like that feeling of not knowing.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: Going out into the world, exploring the unknown, embracing new challenges, that's what I'm used to.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: But didn't you tell me before that you aren't from this world? You came here as a traveler, too, didn't you?

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: And you ended up staying to look for your missing sibling, correct?

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: #Don't worry. As long as {F#he}{M#she} is still in this world, the two of you will meet again.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: That's if I have a say in the matter. As a fellow outlander, I won't let you do this alone.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: I'll be ready to help whenever you need me.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: Wherever the hunt leads, I won't turn you down.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: In the meantime... when you have a moment, tell me more of what you know about this world.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: Starting with hilichurls, Abyss Mages, and Geovishap Hatchlings... I still don't know where any of their weak spots are!

choices.text: I would love to visit your world.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: If you ever do have the chance, you should take it.

response.speaker: Aloy
response.text: My world has its troubles. But it's worth seeing. And worth saving.
